About Mr. Venki’s new unit

This is a separate new design from the supplied SketchUp model: 11 feet wide, 7 feet high and up to 2 feet deep. Two double-door cabinets have handleless beige-matte shutters and four evenly spaced shelves each.

The fixed tall front is beige, with a smaller walnut-brown side section. The walnut brown matte side shutter has rear-edge hinges and opens inward toward the mirror. Behind it is one hanging rod only. The mirror surround and four open compartments use walnut brown matte mica. The makeup drawer is beige matte and handleless; the table uses brown mica.

Touch the mirror to control its warm-white lighting. Rotate, zoom, open the doors and drawer, or change mica finishes. Choices save in this browser.

Exact laminate shade/grain, panel thicknesses, shutter reveals and rod placement are visual approximations pending fabrication details. The mirror appearance is illustrative. Source geometry is retained under Reference colours. Pricing has not been imported.
